_comment: Patches on Yahoo PLAYERLIST rows that are wrong UPSTREAM. Applied by scripts/fetch_playerlist.py after parsing and before writing, so they survive every refetch; scripts/check_playerlist.py lists the live ones and FAILS on any past review_by, or whose Yahoo row no longer matches 'replaces' (upstream may be fixed). Keyed by Yahoo player id. 'set' may name projectedFPPG (a number) and player_proj_GP (a number, or "team": the most games remaining Yahoo projects for any teammate in the same fetch). Total FP is derived, FPPG x GP. See modules/projection_overrides.py.
